summary_md: **makevoid ([@makevoid](https://x.com/makevoid/status/2116262248545182078))** rounds up his open-source work: **Godocta**, a Godot 4 voxel studio entirely coded by Opus 5.5, **mk-video-editing**, a Claude Code skill from raw footage to finished edit, and a motion-graphics music-video skill ([makevoid/godocta](https://github.com/makevoid/godocta), [makevoid/mk-video-editing](https://github.com/makevoid/mk-video-editing), [makevoid/motion-graphics-music-video-skill](https://github.com/makevoid/motion-graphics-music-video-skill)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - makevoid/godocta: Octa · Structure Studio — build, paint and explore truncated-octahedron structures in Godot 4, with 85 procedural builds and a Go generator
